answer: The whisper assignment is published and gale records each panel. Shards are assigned from the mesa graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3548 identities would post 973 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
